Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 20-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Neural Computation and Applications [IT_4404]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                How does the functioning of the human brain influence the design and working principles of artificial (5)  
  neural networks in detecting and interpreting patterns?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           A voice recognition system learns to understand accents better as it listens to more people         (5)  
  speaking. Over time, it improves accuracy without being reprogrammed.  
  What are the different types of learning processes in neural networks? Explain each with a suitable  
  example.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                Apply the Perceptron Model to classify input data and explain how its key components contribute to (5)  
  the decision-making process.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Explain the relationship between the Perceptron and Bayes Classifier for a Gaussian environment.      (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3)                In a weather prediction system, past data is combined with current observations to make accurate      (5)  
  forecasts. Discuss how MAP Estimation helps in improving such predictions.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           A signal processing unit receives mixed signals containing both desired and interfering               (5)  
  components. Explain how the filtering structure is designed to separate useful signals from noise.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Apply the Backpropagation Algorithm to explain how weights are adjusted in a Multilayer               (5)  
  Perceptron (MLP) during the learning process.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyze how the Radial-Basis Function Network (RBFN) differs from a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) (5)  
  in terms of structure and learning approach  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  Page #1

5)                        Demonstrate how word embedding techniques such as Word2Vec or GloVe represent words as               (5)  
  vectors in a neural network model.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Examine the differences between LSTM and GRU architectures in handling long-term                     (5)  
  dependencies in sequential data.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  -----End-----
